title: Authorize CP11d Historical Integrity relocation bridge
goal: Pre-authorize the exact trusted-base and policy-registry bridge required before relocating Historical Integrity into the Post stage.
acceptanceCriteria: The trusted-base authorization binds the exact transition selectors, tests and registry tuple.
The weaken-policy authorization covers only the temporary policy-config destination registration.
The authorization-only change modifies no trusted component or production policy.
The bridge candidate consumes both authorizations in the same protected diff.
